callout.text: Love every part of the body

storyboard.claim: Her safe life in Ohio is broken when slave catchers come up the road.

storyboard.addedInformation: The road icon shows arrival literally.
storyboard.staging: Sethe looks afraid at the road where the catchers come.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Cause and effect of her collapse.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the arithmetic the host describes as a chain.
storyboard.staging: Diagram beat with Baby Suggs in the room as a small reference.

storyboard.addedInformation: Clarifies that the failure was capacity, not belief.
storyboard.staging: Baby Suggs, sad and thoughtful, the ledger named in the callout.

storyboard.staging: Baby Suggs sits blank: she has nothing left to give.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Her instant reaction.

storyboard.staging: Host looks uneasy: the reaction is the horror.
